title: 'We have to get over that hump': Jets lament collapse against Raiders, struggles in one-score games

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 'We have to get over that hump': Jets lament collapse against Raiders, struggles in one-score games
sources.description: Garrett Wilson, Geno Smith and Aaron Glenn stressed accountability after New York's latest late-game collapse extended its losing streak to three games.
